About the company
CROFTI Pty Ltd (ABN 64 169 326 514), trading as CROFTI, is a Brisbane-based technology consultancy delivering ICT solutions, smarter systems and automation services to construction and manufacturing businesses across Australia.
 
About the role
The ICT Sales Representative develops and converts sales opportunities into sales of ICT services, software and related business solutions.
 
In this role at CROFTI you will perform:
•	Building and managing a pipeline of business clients, identifying organisations that would benefit from CROFTI's AI and automation solutions
•	Running discovery sessions that go deeper than surface-level needs, mapping a client's processes, systems and data, and identifying constraints, dependencies and integration risks early, before they derail a project
•	Scoping technical and business requirements at a high level and translating them into a clearly defined CROFTI engagement, working with the delivery team to pressure-test feasibility before anything is promised
•	Discussing solution architecture, integrations and implementation realistically with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
•	Maintaining current knowledge of CROFTI's services, the business-software and automation landscape, and competitor offerings
•	Preparing and presenting proposals; quoting, negotiating scope, pricing and terms; and closing engagements
•	Managing accounts and pipeline in HubSpot and reporting to management on activity, results and market feedback
•	Following up post-engagement to ensure the solution landed, resolving issues and uncovering further opportunities
 
Requirements
Applicants must have:
•	A bachelor degree in any discipline, or equivalent professional experience in technology sales
•	A minimum of 5 years' experience in ICT or technology sales
 
Applicants who do not meet the above criteria will not be considered.
 
How to apply: Apply online.

Position Available: Waiter Supervisor
Location: Darwin, Northern Territory
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary: $67,510–$75,000

ABOUT US
Skills and Hands NT Pty Ltd is a Northern Territory-based consultancy focused on workforce planning, talent engagement, and sustainable staffing strategies. We work alongside local businesses to support the development of strong, reliable teams through tailored pathways that align with their long-term goals. Our role is to facilitate practical workforce solutions that help employers attract and retain skilled talent—contributing to the resilience and continuity of operations across the Territory.

ABOUT THE EMPLOYER
We are supporting a hospitality group (SXW Pty Ltd) based in Darwin that operates across several popular venues, specialising in Aussie-Italian and Aussie-Filipino fusion cuisine. The business is known for it's commitment to handcrafted meals, warm service, and consistent customer satisfaction. They are currently hiring for the following role: Waiter Supervisor. These roles offer a great opportunity to join a dynamic team and grow within a stable, fast-paced hospitality environment.

WAITER SUPERVISOR
Job Overview:
As a Waiter Supervisor, you will oversee front-of-house service, lead the team, and ensure excellent guest experiences during each shift.

Key Responsibilities:
Supervise and support front-of-house staff.
Manage daily operations and rosters.
Train new team members and uphold service standards.
Address and resolve customer issues promptly.

Requirements:
Experience in hospitality supervision or team leadership.
Strong organisational and interpersonal skills.
Availability for weekends, holidays, and evening shifts.

HOW TO APPLY
We are looking for professionals who are passionate about hospitality and can demonstrate their experience clearly and confidently.

To apply, submit the following:
Resume outlining your work experience and references.
A short cover letter (max. 300 words) explaining:
Why you are applying for this position; and
An example of when you showed excellent service, initiative, or teamwork (use the STAR method: Situation, Task, Action, Result).
A Written Response (max. 600 words) describing how your skills and experience align with the responsibilities of the role you are applying for. Please structure your example(s) using the STAR method.

* Only complete applications that address all three components will be considered. Incomplete or generic submissions will not be shortlisted.

If you are interested in joining a vibrant team and contributing to a high-quality hospitality experience, we look forward to receiving your application.

Apply online only. Walk-in applications will not be accepted.

Are you an experienced Chef De Partie looking to take the next step in a busy, well-established kitchen? Join The River Hotel in the beautiful town of Margaret River, WA 6285. You will work closely with the Head Chef and senior kitchen team to deliver consistent, high-quality food and maintain strong standards across preparation, service, and kitchen operations.

Key Responsibilities

•	Prepare and cook high-quality meals in line with venue standards
•	Manage and maintain your allocated section during preparation and service

•	Assist with menu preparation, specials, and food presentation

•	Maintain consistency, portion control, and quality across all dishes
•	Ensure proper stock rotation, storage, and waste minimisation
•	Maintain a clean, organised, and efficient work area
•	Follow all food safety, workplace health, and hygiene standards

What We Are Looking For

•	Minimum 1 years of full-time or part-time equivalent experience as a Chef De Partie, or strong Demi Chef ready to step up

•	Ability to work efficiently under pressure in a busy service environment

•	A practical, hands-on approach and willingness to work as part of a team

What We Offer

•	A Competitive remuneration between $79,500 to $85,000 plus super, based on experience
•	Stable, well-established venue with consistent trade
•	Supportive senior kitchen team and professional working environment

If you take pride in well-executed food, work well under pressure, and value consistency over shortcuts, we would like to hear from you.

Applications open on 7 July 2026 and close on 6 August 2026

About the Position
This position organises, controls and coordinates the strategic and operational management of horticulture facilities to ensure efficient physical operations and safe, productive environments for staff and facility users.
Occupation Tasks
*	Manage the shed floor on a day-to-day basis.
*	Ensure all cool rooms are operating correctly.
*	Ensure all produce is packed to specifications efficiently and without compromising quality.
*	Ensure the logistics supervisor has product available in a timely fashion and to the required quality standard so product can be delivered in full and on time.
*	Lead a team of staff who manage the packing shed floor efficiently.
*	Maintain a high standard of work practices at all times.
*	Liaise with the post-harvest operations manager to predetermine daily and weekly objectives.
*	Assist the post-harvest operations manager in supervising staff engaged in quality control, residue limit monitoring and protocol requirements for all markets, especially export markets.
*	Liaise with grower services teams and farm managers to ensure smooth delivery of fresh produce for packing.
*	Ensure protocol and MRL requirements advised by technical services, and customer requirements set by marketing, are implemented in the packing and logistics process, especially traceability, labelling and documentation.
*	Supervise quality control of produce being packed to ensure it meets packing instruction requirements.
*	Assist to oversee procurement of temporary labour, consumables, freight and other services required to move produce from farms through the supply chain to customers.
*	Operate traceability management systems and processes to ensure the shed floor is run cost effectively without compromising quality output, and recommend improvements where required.
*	Assist in developing plans for refurbishment, maintenance and continuous improvement of facility assets.
*	Assist in managing relationships with external service providers, growers and other stakeholders.
*	Provide input into project cost analysis and budget preparation.
*	Follow Occupational Health and Safety policies/procedures and help ensure packing shed staff comply with occupational health and safety and quality assurance requirements.
*	Assist in completing quality system documentation.

Skills, Experience and Qualifications
The following requirements are reproduced from the position Job Description:
*	relevant AQF Certificate III or Certificate IV qualifications or equivalent; or 
*	3 years employment experience as a Facility Plant Manager with relevant formal training; or
*	5 years employment experience as a Facility Plant Manager with no formal training.

Market Salary 	$72,000- $80,000 per annum plus superannuation

COOK – FULL TIME

Business: TASTE OF XIANG PTY LTD (ABN 72 663 861 158)
Trading Name: Little Corner BBQ
Location: 28 Wills Street, Melbourne VIC 3000
Salary: AU$75,000 – AU$85,000 per annum + Superannuation (commensurate with qualifications and experience)
Employment Type: Full-time (minimum 38 hours per week)

Job Published:  7 July 2026

ABOUT THE BUSINESS
Little Corner BBQ is a contemporary Chinese restaurant located in Melbourne's CBD, specialising in authentic Chinese charcoal barbecue and regional Asian cuisine prepared using traditional cooking techniques and quality ingredients. The restaurant offers an extensive menu featuring premium meat, poultry, seafood, vegetable, and specialty barbecue dishes, complemented by freshly prepared side dishes and seasonal menu offerings.
Operating across lunch and dinner service, Little Corner BBQ is committed to delivering authentic flavours, consistent food quality, and exceptional customer service within a vibrant and fast-paced hospitality environment. The commercial kitchen focuses on fresh ingredient preparation, traditional Chinese barbecue cooking methods, quality control, efficient kitchen operations, and strict compliance with Australian food safety and workplace health and safety requirements.

ABOUT THE ROLE
Little Corner BBQ has an opportunity available for an experienced Cook to join its kitchen team on a full-time basis.
This is a hands-on operational role responsible for preparing, cooking, and presenting authentic Chinese barbecue dishes and a diverse range of Asian-inspired cuisine in accordance with established recipes, quality standards, and service requirements. The successful candidate will contribute to all aspects of kitchen operations including food preparation, commercial cooking, stock control, quality assurance, and maintaining a safe and efficient commercial kitchen environment.
The role requires the ability to manage allocated kitchen sections, coordinate workflow during busy lunch and dinner service periods, maintain consistency in food quality and presentation, and work collaboratively with kitchen and front-of-house staff to ensure efficient service delivery and customer satisfaction.
This is a full-time permanent position based on a minimum 38-hour working week.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Food Preparation and Cooking
1.	Prepare, cook, and present a broad range of authentic Chinese barbecue dishes and Asian cuisine in accordance with established recipes and presentation standards.
2.	Prepare premium meat, poultry, seafood, vegetables, and other ingredients using appropriate preparation techniques including cutting, trimming, marinating, seasoning, skewering, and portioning.
3.	Apply appropriate commercial cooking techniques including charcoal grilling, roasting, stir-frying, deep-frying, steaming, braising, and sautéing while maintaining consistency in flavour, texture, and presentation.
4.	Monitor cooking times, temperatures, seasoning, and food quality throughout preparation and service.
5.	Prepare sauces, marinades, seasonings, and accompanying ingredients in accordance with established recipes and business standards.

Kitchen Operations and Service Delivery
1.	Support efficient kitchen workflow during lunch and dinner service to ensure timely preparation and delivery of customer orders.
2.	Manage allocated kitchen sections while maintaining organised, clean, and service-ready workstations.
3.	Work collaboratively with kitchen and front-of-house staff to ensure accurate order preparation and efficient service delivery.
4.	Assist with daily menu preparation, specialty barbecue items, and seasonal menu offerings.
5.	Maintain consistency in food quality, presentation, and portion control across all menu items.

Stock Control and Kitchen Organisation
1.	Assist with receiving, inspecting, storing, and rotating food supplies in accordance with established stock control procedures.
2.	Apply FIFO stock rotation principles to minimise spoilage and maintain product freshness.
3.	Monitor ingredient usage and report stock shortages or purchasing requirements to management.
4.	Participate in stocktakes and maintain organised storage areas.
5.	Ensure appropriate labelling, storage, and handling of food products in accordance with food safety requirements.
Food Safety and Compliance
1.	Maintain compliance with Australian Food Safety Standards and safe food handling practices.
2.	Maintain high standards of hygiene and cleanliness throughout food preparation areas, equipment, utensils, and workstations.
3.	Monitor food storage, preparation, cooking, cooling, and holding temperatures to ensure compliance with food safety requirements.
4.	Follow workplace cleaning schedules, sanitation procedures, and operational policies.
5.	Comply with Workplace Health and Safety requirements, including the safe operation of commercial kitchen equipment.

General Duties and Team Contribution
1.	Maintain a clean, organised, and efficient workstation throughout each shift.
2.	Follow instructions from senior kitchen staff and management with accuracy and attention to detail.
3.	Work collaboratively within a team environment to support efficient kitchen operations during busy service periods.
4.	Demonstrate reliability, professionalism, punctuality, and a positive approach to work.
5.	Participate in ongoing workplace training and continuous professional development to enhance culinary knowledge and operational performance.

MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS
1.	Relevant qualification in Commercial Cookery (Certificate III or higher) or a closely related field.
2.	Minimum one (1) year of relevant full-time experience within a commercial kitchen environment.
3.	Previous experience preparing Chinese barbecue, Asian cuisine, or similar regional cuisine within a commercial restaurant environment will be highly regarded.
4.	Demonstrated experience preparing and cooking food within a commercial restaurant or hospitality environment.
5.	Sound knowledge of Australian Food Safety Standards, food hygiene, and safe food handling practices.
6.	Ability to work efficiently within a fast-paced commercial kitchen environment.
7.	Availability to work evenings, weekends, public holidays, and rostered shifts as required.

KEY COMPETENCIES
1.	Technical commercial cookery skills.
2.	Chinese barbecue and Asian cuisine preparation.
3.	Food preparation, cooking, and presentation.
4.	Ingredient preparation, marination, seasoning, and grilling techniques.
5.	Time management and organisational skills.
6.	Kitchen workflow and operational awareness.
7.	Communication and teamwork.
8.	Attention to detail and quality control.
9.	Food safety and regulatory compliance.
10.	Commitment to continuous improvement and professional standards.

HOW TO APPLY
Please submit a one-page CV outlining your relevant qualifications, experience, and availability.
Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

result.description:
Woodford Hotel (Deery Hotels Pty Ltd) is looking for full-time Chefs and Cooks to join their kitchen team in Woodford QLD.  

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

Demonstrate understanding of food preparation and production in the kitchen department, whilst taking direction from the Head Chef to ensure smooth operation of all kitchen duties. 

The position will involve: 

* Ensures the consistency of all menu items regardless of time of day or period of service 
* Day to day effective involvement in food operations. 
* Liaising with Head Chef and kitchen team to ensure smooth delivery of food to guests. 
* Operation of kitchen equipment to achieve required results for ala carte and function service 
* Work with the head chef to advance and improve current food operations. 
* Has understanding of stock control and works together with the Head Chef to minimize wastage. 
* Compliance and understanding of food safety policy and procedures (HACCP) 
* Follows kitchen systems, policies, and procedures on shift. 
* Responding to the Head Chefs requests to perform other tasks from time to time which contribute to the overall success of the venue's operations. 
* Maintaining service standards particularly during peak periods 
* Maintain a 'Can-do' attitude in the face of adversity 

QUALIFICATIONS/REQUIREMENTS 

* All applicants must have at least 2 years of experience in a commercial kitchen 
* Commercial cookery qualifications are preferred but not essential. All applicants are encourage to apply. 
* A positive, friendly and enthusiastic attitude 
* The ability to excel under pressure in a high-volume environment with excellent problem-solving skills 
* Strong communication, negotiation and relationship skills 

SALARY : $65,000 - $85,000 per year 

Apply now!

location.label: QLD - Brisbane & Gold Coast - Outer North Brisbane

result.title: Chefs and Cooks
